# Viewer environment assets

| File | Source | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `small_empty_room_3_1k.hdr` | [Small Empty Room 3](https://polyhaven.com/a/small_empty_room_3) on Poly Haven, 1k HDR | CC0 |
| `small_empty_room_3_4k.jpg` | Same asset, the tonemapped JPG downscaled from 8192×4096 to 4096×2048 (JPEG quality 85) | CC0 |

The HDR lights the wardrobe and feeds mirror reflections in the viewer's "Room" backdrop. The JPG is the
visible backdrop. Both are self-hosted so the app makes no third-party requests.
